notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.10.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - File mo bang app HPCONS BIM Viewer (cai qua Chrome / Edge) hay bi hien icon TRANG: moi lan app cap nhat, Chrome ghi de icon rong. - Bo cai them chuong trinh nho C:\Program Files\HPCONS\IconFix\HpconsIconFix.exe: tu chay khi dang nhap (moi nguoi dung tren may), chay nen khong cua so, gan lai icon ngay khi Chrome / Edge ghi de (khong can chay script tay nua). Icon moi cho file .xmind. - Go bo cai thi chuong trinh duoc go theo.
